descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Enter the spaceship of the imagination. Powers of 10 is a new VR app from HolloLab. Traverse spacetime on a beam of light & cosmic zoom across all orders of magnitude: from multiverse to string scale, Big Bang, to human brain, to black hole.

Part VR simulation of the universe, part educational game, Powers of 10 invites you to explore the wonders of our universe & probe its deepest mysteries in mind-blowing scientific visualizations generated by NASA datasets & CT/MRI medical imaging scans, interactive art by HolloLab & IMC Lab artists & perception-shifting ideas of cosmic interconnectedness.

Learn & play in 3D data visualizations of the body, brain, heart, lungs, city, Earth, International Space Station, Solar System, Milky Way Galaxy, Virgo Galaxy Cluster, Cosmic Microwave Background Radiation, multiverse, micro-organisms, cells, virus, DNA, atoms, quarks, strings, & Planck scale, as well as Cosmic Calendar from Big Bang to today, the tree of life & more.
